**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Move the Valkey case into its dependency-owning suite**

When the standard Redis matrix is selected, `tests/contrib/suitespec.yml:2241-2271` runs all of `tests/contrib/redis` while installing `redis` but not `valkey`; this top-level import therefore raises `ModuleNotFoundError: valkey` during collection in every Redis environment, before any test can run. Move the Valkey cases to `tests/contrib/valkey` (whose suite installs that package) or otherwise keep each case in an environment that owns its dependency.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L8-L9](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-py/blob/18402db86df51fcd7d778bff4de61f4c26f90996/AGENTS.md#L8-L9)

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Run the regression under a bytes-warning interpreter**

When this test runs in the configured Redis suite, `tests/contrib/suitespec.yml:2255` invokes plain `pytest`, so `sys.flags.bytes_warning` is 0. CPython only generates `BytesWarning` for bytes/non-bytes comparisons under `-b` or `-bb`; `warnings.simplefilter` changes the handling of generated warnings but does not enable their generation. Consequently, the `INCR` case also passes against the pre-change implementation and cannot prevent this regression; run it in a `-b` subprocess or directly assert that `determine_row_count` is not called.

**![P1](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-E86A10?style=flat) Avoid requiring Valkey in Redis-only test environments** The Redis test environments install redis but not valkey. This unconditional import loads a module that immediately imports valkey, causing ModuleNotFoundError during collection and preventing the Redis suite from running. Split the Valkey cases into the Valkey suite, or supply the dependency in every environment collecting this file. React: 👍 useful · 👎 wrong · 😕 unclear · 👀 right, but not acting on it

**![P2](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-F5C518?style=flat) Make the regression test detect unnecessary row counting** The standard Redis suite runs Python without -b, so bytes/int comparisons emit no BytesWarning for this filter to promote. The new cases therefore pass against the original buggy computation. Assert that non-row commands never call determine_row_count, or execute the reproduction in a subprocess with -b, so CI detects a recurrence. ```suggestion from unittest import mock with warnings.catch_warnings(), mock.patch.object( module, "determine_row_count", wraps=module.determine_row_count ) as determine: warnings.simplefilter("error", BytesWarning) run(None, lambda *a, **k: result, args, {}) assert determine.call_count == (0 if expected is None else 1) ``` React: 👍 useful · 👎 wrong · 😕 unclear · 👀 right, but not acting on it
